_comment: Weapons, armor and implants. 'req' are the minimums needed to use the item ('attributes.str', 'weapons.standard', 'tech.research' ...). 'research' is the Research skill needed before an alien item can be used. 'w'/'h' are the inventory cells the icon occupies; each category's 'rows' is the height of its inventory grid (items fill it column by column). 'tech' lists the Maintain / Modify (1st / 2nd) / Repair skill each weapon needs for upkeep (shown for information only). Implants ('implant': true) can be equipped, 1 slot or 2 with the Cybernetically Enhanced O/S upgrade; 'bonus' adds to those levels when checking other items' requirements, unless 'bonusIgnoredForReq' is set (ExperTech).

items.name: Wrench
items.desc: A very solid wrench. A heavy maintenance tool that makes an effective makeshift weapon. Needs no weapon skill; damage scales with Strength.

items.name: Pistol
items.desc: Talon M2A3 .45 caliber pistol, the UNN standard-issue sidearm. Accepts standard, armor-piercing and anti-personnel rounds.

items.name: Shotgun
items.desc: A magazine-loaded 10 gauge monster. Fires rifled slugs or anti-personnel shells, with a triple-load shot.

items.name: Assault Rifle
items.desc: M-22 Assault Rifle. Uses pistol ammunition with a bigger clip and 25% more damage. Single shot or fully automatic.

items.name: Laser Pistol
items.desc: Apollo H4 argon-suspension laser pistol. Refracted light, a large rechargeable battery and an overcharge setting for tight spots.

items.name: Laser Rapier
items.desc: Mark IV laser rapier. A brutally effective melee blade that releases intense refracted light on impact. Needs no ammunition.

items.name: EMP Rifle
items.desc: Dual-circuit EMP rifle. Devastating against robots, cyborgs and turrets, harmless to organic targets.

items.name: Grenade Launcher
items.desc: TC-11 "Brick" grenade launcher. Fires fragmentation, proximity, incendiary, EMP and disruption grenades.

items.name: Stasis Field Generator
items.desc: Fires a stasis field that freezes targets in place. Uses prisms; the effect weakens with distance.

items.name: Fusion Cannon
items.desc: TC-5 Fusion Cannon. Fires a slow, powerful projectile that explodes on impact. Normal and death mode; uses prisms.

items.name: Crystal Shard
items.desc: A long, dangerous fragment of annelid crystal, razor sharp. Must be researched before use.

items.name: Viral Proliferator
items.desc: Releases a nanite-virus payload tuned against annelids or humans. Hold the trigger; the payload detonates on release. Uses worm clusters.

items.name: Annelid Launcher
items.desc: Fires heat-seeking worms that home in on the closest target. Uses worm clusters collected in beakers.

items.name: Psi Amp
items.desc: Black-Ops Psionic Amplifier. Channels the psionic disciplines bought at Psi Upgrade Units. Has no requirements itself, but it is useless without at least one discipline.

items.name: Light Combat Armor
items.desc: Dartech class 1 armor. Kevlar and steel mesh; lightweight, marginally effective protection.

items.name: Medium Combat Armor
items.desc: SenniTech class 3 armor. Triple-layered composite resins and polymers, standard light infantry issue.

items.name: Heavy Combat Armor
items.desc: UltraTech class 5 combat armor. Titanium/kevlar panels over a regenerative gel. The best you can get without power.

items.name: Powered Armor
items.desc: Class 7 armor with a repulsion field. Excellent protection while charged, none when the battery is empty.

items.name: Hazard Suit
items.desc: TriOptimum Zero-Phase hazard armor. Protects against radiation and chemical hazards, but not against combat damage.

items.name: WormSkin Armor
items.desc: Tough annelid skin fashioned into a body covering. Boosts PSI but slowly drains psi points. Must be researched.
items.stats: +2 PSI · 20% combat damage reduction · 30% less rad/toxin intake

items.name: BrawnBoost™ Implant
items.desc: Stimulates the musculature with electric and magnetic impulses. Burns 1% of its charge every ten seconds.

items.name: EndurBoost™ Implant
items.desc: Stimulates nerve fibers and muscle tissue and filters fatigue toxins from the blood. Burns 1% of its charge every ten seconds.

items.name: SwiftBoost™ Implant
items.desc: Speeds up reaction times for the entire body. Burns 1% of its charge every ten seconds.

items.name: PsiBoost™ Implant
items.desc: Keeps neurotransmitter levels optimal for peak neural function. Burns 1% of its charge every ten seconds.

items.name: LabAssistant™ Implant
items.desc: Crigon's least popular implant, kept alive by graduate students. Burns 1% of its charge every ten seconds.

items.name: ExperTech™ Implant
items.desc: Boosts technical skills. The bonus does NOT count toward minimum skill requirements. Burns 1% of its charge every ten seconds.

items.name: WormMind Implant
items.desc: When you take damage, one of every four points is subtracted from psi points instead of hit points. Must be researched.
items.stats: 25% of damage taken from psi points

items.name: WormBlood Implant
items.desc: While active, right-click a pile of worms to heal yourself. Must be researched.

items.name: WormHeart Implant
items.desc: While powered you take no damage from annelid toxin and regenerate 1 HP every 30 seconds. Releases toxin into your blood when it runs out or is removed. Must be researched.
